prompt:
Create a production animation sprite atlas of the EXACT crimsonDisciple character in the supplied reference. Genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop, no floor, no shadows outside figure, no labels or grid lines. Preserve the dark-brown-skinned male face, crimson split robe, two vials/low cowl for disciple or three vials/broad armored black mantle/angular headwrap for adept, boots and small ritual knife; same equipment in every pose. Original Heroes III rich painted/prerendered matte wool, worn leather, dull steel, strong compact silhouette, low three-quarter battle camera, lit upper left; no modern glossy 3D or cartoon. GRID STRICTLY 6 COLUMNS BY 8 ROWS, exactly 48 separated equal square cells; each figure fits inside its own cell with generous margin, identical camera/body scale all cells. Ground contact baseline at 88% cell height, standing height 60% of cell height, central hip at50%cellwidth. Face screen RIGHT except turns. Each row reads left to right as a continuous action, genuine articulated arms/legs/body changes, never duplicate idle for an action.
ROW1 six-step WALK CYCLE: left support/right forward, transition, right contact, right support/left forward, transition, left contact. Feet clearly separated below split robe.
ROW2 first4frames FIDGET: rest, reach vial belt, check small vial, return. Last2cells idle at rest.
ROW3 first4frames HIT: rest, chest flinches backward, hunched impact, recovery. Last2cells idle.
ROW4 first4frames DEFEND: rest, knees bend and arms rise, knife forearm braced across chest with other hand warding, recover. Last2cells idle.
ROW5 sixframe DEATH: rest, struck backward, knees buckle, dropping to knees, falling on side, final unmistakably prone corpse on ground. Final corpse remains entirely in its cell.
ROW6 first4frames TURN TOWARD VIEWER: right-facing, right-front threequarter, front-facing, right-facing again. Last2cells idle.
ROW7 first4frames TURN AWAY: right-facing, right-rear threequarter, back-facing, right-facing again. Last2cells idle.
ROW8 six-step separate ADVENTURE MAP WALK: same character from slightly more overhead threequarter, small readable silhouette, six distinct walking leg phases.
Keep shot projectiles, magic clouds, blood/gore, scenery and extra characters absent. The worn small Noxian cloth crest is the reference design, never a Demacian sword/wings. This is an animation asset sheet, not a concept lineup. Make actual movements especially death and turns readable.
